{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Canada|Cuisine of Canada]]

==Ingredients==
*4 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] (125 [[Cookbook:g|g]]) softened [[Cookbook:Cream Cheese|cream cheese]]
*3½ [[Cookbook:cup|cup]]s (875 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) [[Cookbook:Icing Sugar|icing sugar]]
*⅛ [[Cookbook:teaspoon|teaspoon]] (0.5 ml) [[Cookbook:Mint|peppermint]] flavouring
*¾ cup (175 ml) white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]

==Procedure==
# Combine cream cheese, icing sugar and peppermint flavouring in large bowl. Stir until mixed.
# Roll dough into small balls.
# Roll balls in bowl of icing sugar.
# Press small balls with bottom of glass until flat.
# Chill. Store in airtight container.
